title: Resale File Fees Deducted from Sale Proceeds — Home Purchase Financing Paydowns
content:
**Resale file settlement note — Home Purchase Financing borrowers selling through In-Place Home Resale**

Where the resale package deducts fees owed from the proceeds and the home is occupied, the resale fees deducted are the fees owed on the resale file; where the package deducts fees owed from the proceeds and the home is vacant, the resale fees deducted are the fees owed on the resale file plus one month's vacant-home check fee of the package. Where the package does not deduct fees owed from the proceeds, this note sets no resale fees deducted.

The package terms, the fees owed on the file and the home's occupancy (occupied or vacant) are read from the In-Place Home Resale file under contract.

| Package deducts fees owed from the proceeds | Home occupancy | Resale fees deducted |
|---|---|---|
| yes | occupied | fees owed on the resale file |
| yes | vacant | fees owed on the resale file plus one month's vacant-home check fee |
| no | either | not set by this note |

### Questions the note answers

**Are these the fees owed on the loan?** No — they are the fees owed on the resale file. Fees owed on the loan stay on the payoff.

**Hypothetical figures.** With 180.00 owed on the resale file and a monthly vacant-home check fee of 45.00, an occupied home gives 180.00 and a vacant one 225.00.
